verdict.rationale: Fenwick Labs mentions "automated generation of incorporation documents for new startups" and "online term-sheet generation for M&A clients." That points to document-automation tooling, but the pack never shows that founders can use it self-serve or that it involves interactive online assembly. The Startup Resource Center offers articles, checklists and unspecified "other tools" rather than evidenced interactive document assembly. Missing for 10: evidence that founders access the tooling directly without lawyer mediation, a description of the interactive assembly workflow, the specific document types covered beyond a passing mention, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
